This slab inscribed by Alderman O'Donnell Mayor 1885 to the memory of Alderman Robert Cane who during his second mayorality in 1849 denoted his salary to the erection of this lodge.
The right honorable Earl of Desart Mayor 1810.

The above stone was taken from the old and placed on the new St. John's bridge designed in the mayorality of the Hon Otway Cuffe Mayor of Kilkenny 1907-1908 grandson of the above named Earl of Desart.

Dedicated to the memory of William H Walsh 1915-1999 who commissioned the restauration of these Ormonde Stables and Butler House on behalf of the Government of Ireland. Founder of Kilkenny Design Workshops in 1963 and chairman until his retirement in 1976

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.
